summary:
w196 planned: r73 (1041, 1052), r123 (1063), r124 (1076) go green; the deprecated r73 scenarios 1021 and 1031 are retired.
r73: Drafts.retires follows each Deprecated for: line to its replacement (by title, any file) and the replacement's @r tag; a deprecated scenario's own tags count for nothing; each scenario is listed once (D1, D2).
r123: a new drafting function writes one retire work-item in the run's initiative, copying part_of/under/accepts from the last-drafted (highest-numbered) green replacement work-item. A replacement counts as green when every non-withdrawn work-item accepting it is green. Scenarios already in a non-withdrawn work-item's Retires are skipped, which stops redrafts and loops.
r124: pull_through drafts it after the pull and before the branch-review check, pushes, and pulls again.
workqueue.add's Retires line takes the capability and tag from each entry (one expression changed), since a retire work-item can span capabilities.
New step module supervision_retire_steps.py; thing_feature_deprecated and retires_listed are removed with the retired scenarios.
No question.
